commands.result: Both candidate hashes match; layers H -> F/M/A -> R -> I. All dependencies exist and parallel file ownership does not overlap.
Default feature compilation passes; project/s0 gated exports exist.

verified_contracts: AST/model new fields and ownership make frontend data/extern/slice lowering consumable by backend without concurrent shared-file edits.
DataObject initialized bytes and BSS are disjoint; static pointers use ABS64, runtime symbol addresses PCREL; machine images and assembly reference share the data contract.
Extern FunctionId entries preserve existing call references, are omitted from emitted bodies, and require an explicitly supplied s0 text definition.
Project parsing is std-only with a concrete manifest structure; R uses library-level composition and therefore does not depend on I CLI.
Source payload and result execution, short I/O failures, missing symbols, permissions, BSS/relocations, reproducibility and code accounting remain mandatory final integration requirements.
limitations: Architecture/interface acceptance only. Language, runtime, scanner, project CLI, and s0 implementations are not approved by this review.
Default feature check does not exercise gated missing modules; implementing F/M/A is required before full feature checks can pass.
Full R1a, SOS and self-compilation are explicitly outside this B2 contract.
